title: Is Canada building a future for billionaires, or for the people?
text:
Ksi Lisims, a climate-polluting methane gas export facility, threatens not only the northern coast of B.C., but it could also drain the wallets of people living in Canada for decades to come.
             
            Now, for the cherry on top: Ksi Lisims is 100% Trump-backed and owned by an American company called Western LNG. A company that has never built an LNG terminal.

Ksi Lisims is a bad bet for Canada. It will weaken our economy and democracy, and harm the planet while lining the pockets of US billionaires. And we have the receipts to prove it.
